shared_elements: horizontal registers/bands of repeated small marks across a flat surface
justification: The only correspondence is the generic one of a flat surface organized into horizontal registers of repeated small incised elements. A shows a specific ornamental scheme (a band of multi-petalled rosettes above a band of palmette/lotus scrolls above an arcade with crosshatched pendants), while B shows dense rows of linear script-like signs with no floral, vegetal or architectural motifs at all.
